title: Get a test lead
content_data:
Use this endpoint to get a test lead. ### Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path|/v1.2/pages/leads/mock/get/|/v1.3/page/lead/mock/get/| |Request parameter data type |`advertiser_id`: number
`library_id `: number
`page_id`: number|`advertiser_id`: string
`library_id `: string
`page_id`: string| |Response parameter data type|`lead_id`: number
`page_id`: number
`campaign_id`: number
`adgroup_id`: number
`ad_id`: number
`create_time`: number|`lead_id`:string
`page_id`: string
`campaign_id`: string
`adgroup_id`: string
`ad_id`: string
`create_time`: datetime| ``` ### Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/page/lead/mock/get/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field|Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ```xtable | Field | Type | Description | |---|---|---| | lead_source | string | The source of the lead.

Enum values:
  • `INSTANT_FORM`: a lead generated through an Instant Form.
  • `DIRECT_MESSAGE`: a lead generated from a direct message of the associated Business Account.

Default value: `INSTANT_FORM`. | |advertiser_id {+Conditional}|string| Required when the test lead is under an ad account.

Advertiser ID.

Note: If you pass in this field, you need to be an Admin of the ad account. To obtain the list of ad accounts that you have Admin access to, use [/bc/asset/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1739432717798401). Set `asset_type` to `ADVERTISER` and select ad accounts with the returned `advertiser_role` as `ADMIN`. | |library_id {+Conditional}|string|Required when the test lead is under a form library of a Business Center.

ID of a form library.

To obtain the list of form libraries within a Business Center, use [/page/library/get/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740029915327489). | | page_id {+Conditional}| string |

  • Required when `lead_source` is `INSTANT_FORM` or not specified.
  • Not supported when `lead_source` is `DIRECT_MESSAGE`.

The page ID of an Instant Form.

To obtain a list of Instant Forms, use [/page/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1820826387779586) and set `business_type` to `LEAD_GEN`. | ``` #### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --get -H "Access-Token:xxx" \ --data-urlencode "advertiser_id=ADVERTISER_ID" \ --data-urlencode "page_id=PAGE_ID" \ https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/page/lead/mock/get/ (/code) ``` ### Response ```xtable |Field|Type|Description| |---|---|---| |code |number|The response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message |string|The response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The unique ID of the request, which uniquely identifies a request. | |data |object|The returned data. | #|lead_data|object| The lead data. | #|meta_data|object| Metadata about the lead. | ##| lead_source | string | The source of the lead.

Enum values:
  • `INSTANT_FORM`: a lead generated through an Instant Form.
  • `DIRECT_MESSAGE`: a lead generated from a direct message of the associated Business Account.
| ##|lead_id|string| The lead ID.| ##|page_id|string| Returned only when `lead_source` is `INSTANT_FORM`.

The page ID of the Instant Form. | ##|campaign_id|string| The campaign ID. | ##|campaign_name|string| The campaign name. | ##|adgroup_id|string| The ad group ID.| ##|adgroup_name|string| The ad group name.| ##|ad_id|string| The ad ID | ##|ad_name|string| The ad name. | ##|create_time|datetime| The creation time of the test lead. | ``` #### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code":0, "message":"OK", "request_id":"202208010308080102450041491221C41E", "data":{ "meta_data":{ "create_time":1659323289, "campaign_id":1679105346952197, "campaign_name":"test lead: dummy data for campaign name", "adgroup_id":1679105346954261, "adgroup_name":"test lead: dummy data for ad group name", "lead_id":7126711421177430274, "ad_id":1679105346954262, "ad_name":"test lead: dummy data for ad name", "page_id":6873052183063953666 }, "lead_data":{ "name":"Jane Doe", "phone_number":"8001000000", "Availability":"test lead: dummy data for Availability" } } } (/code); ```
